title: Diagnose why tests/smoke-core tenant specs fail in the advisory Core Smoke job
goal: Explain and dispose of the failures the 2026-09-20 merged-packet closeout surfaced: the advisory, push-only Core Smoke job has been red on 29 of the last 32 completed main runs since at least 2026-09-05, hidden by continue-on-error, and at the 2026-09-20 tip its failure list includes the tests/smoke-core tenant specs. Establish whether those specs fail because the job never provides their preconditions (multi tenant mode plus tenants 101/202 plus matrix fixtures) or because of a real tenant isolation regression, then decide the disposition.
statusNote: 2026-09-20: opened as the FR-011 follow-up from the merged-packet closeout pass. No diagnostic work started yet - this packet records the observed evidence, the ranked hypotheses and the verification plan. Blocked on a runnable local multi-mode stack (this machine has no MySQL on 3306) or on CI-loop iteration.
technicalDebtNote: The tenant specs were placed in tests/smoke-core/, whose glob is executed only by the push-to-main advisory job that provisions no tenant mode and no fixtures; the suite README still lists 8 files and does not mention them. The signal has therefore been red and unrunnable-in-practice since the specs landed, and no PR-path gate covers them.

blockedBy: local multi-mode stack (MySQL on 3306) or CI-loop iteration for reproduction

in: reproduce the tenant-spec failure mode locally against a compat-mode backend and compare it with the CI log assertions
confirm whether the specs carry any precondition skip guard, and what the job actually provides (flag, tenants, fixtures)
triage the two non-tenant failures at the same tip (platform-shell-critical sidebar width assertion, system-dept-operations root-department row) and separate them from the tenant cluster
record the disposition decision and, once decided, the follow-up implementation task
out: changing smoke-core.yml or the specs before the disposition is decided (maintainer gate)
promoting Core Smoke to a blocking gate
product/tenant-isolation code changes unless the diagnosis proves a real leak

doNotTouch: docs/harness/failure-registry.md (FR-011 stays open until the disposition is decided)

commands: gh run list --workflow=smoke-core.yml --branch main --limit 40 + per-run job conclusions (red baseline reconfirmation before/after any change)
gh run view --job <failed core smoke job> --log-failed (per-spec failure inventory at the tip)
locally: start backend in multi mode and run the two tenant matrix specs + tenant-protected-resources (expect green - reproduces the local evidence in 2026-09-20-tenant-hostile-matrix-phase2)
locally: run the same specs against a compat-mode backend (expect the CI failure mode: 'leaked across tenants' assertions)
rg for skip/precondition guards in tests/smoke-core tenant specs and for tenant mode env in .github/workflows/smoke-core.yml
runtimeEvidence: matched failure signatures between the local compat-mode run and the CI job log, or a demonstrated tenant isolation regression
per-spec triage of the two non-tenant failures, with run-id references

evidenceRequired: commands.json with the log reads and the local reproduction runs (commands stay not-run until the diagnosis executes)
summary.md stating the confirmed root cause, the disposition options and their trade-offs
review disposition before any workflow or spec change
humanGates: disposition of the tenant specs in the Core Smoke job: provision multi-mode flag + tenants + fixtures inside the job, mark the specs so the job skips them, or move them to a suite that provisions (maintainer decision)
